Fast Healing 5

Expert Tracker

Fast Healing 5: A Dathomiri Rancor automatically regains 5 Hit Points every round at the end of its turn, up to its normal maximum, until it is killed.

Senses: Low-Light Vision, Perception +11

system.description:
See also: Beasts, Creating New Beasts

Beasts have an Intelligence of 1 or 2. They roll their other five Ability Scores as normal. Beasts that show above average cunning usually have a good Wisdom score.

Beasts increase only one Ability Score by one point every fourth level (instead of increasing two scores by one point each). However, they gain Feats normally as they advance in level. A beast that gains an Intelligence of 3 or higher as a result of an ability increase is eligible to Multiclass.

Beasts do not gain Talents or starting Feats, do not add their Beast Level to their Defenses, and do not gain Force Points or Destiny Points.

Examples of Beasts in Star Wars

Acklay, Dewback, Nexu, Rancor, Reek, Tauntaun, Wampa.

Game Rule Information

Beasts have the following game statistics:

Beast Leveling Statistics

LEVEL

BASE ATTACK BONUS LEVEL BASE ATTACK BONUS

7th +5 17th +12
8th +6 18th +13
9th +6 19th +14
10th +7 20th +15

Hit Points

At each level, Beasts gain a number of Hit Points equal to 1d8 + their Constitution modifier.

Force Points

Beasts do not gain Force Points.

Class Skills

At 1st level, Beasts become Trained in a number of Skills equal to 1 + their Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). They can select their Trained Skills from the below list:

  • Acrobatics
  • Climb
  • Endurance
  • Initiative
  • Jump
  • Perception
  • Stealth
  • Survival
  • Swim

Class Features

Beasts gain special features unique to themselves. See Creature Generator.

Multiclassing

A Beast with an Intelligence of 3 or higher can Multiclass into any Heroic Class. Beasts with an Intelligence of 1 or 2 cannot Multiclass.

Homebrew Class

The Smuggler combines the Scoundrel and Scout classes into one — quick-witted operators equally at home talking their way out of trouble or navigating the wild regions of the galaxy. A Smuggler gains access to all talent trees and bonus feats associated with either Scoundrel or Scout (except Malkite Poisoner and Yuuzhan Vong Biotech), choosing one Talent every odd level and one Bonus Feat every even level from either pool.

See also: Feats

You can follow through with a powerful melee attack.

Prerequisites: Strength 13, Power Attack Feat

Effect: If you deal an opponent enough damage to reduce its hit points to 0, you get an immediate extra melee attack against another opponent within your reach. The extra attack is with the same weapon and at the same attack bonus as the attack that dropped the previous opponent. You can use this ability once per round.

Additional Cleave Effects

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

Combined Feat (Follow Through): If you have the Follow Through Feat, you can move up to your speed before making the extra melee attack granted by the Cleave Feat.

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook

See also: Feats, Grappling 101

You can deal damage to a target that you've Grappled.

Prerequisites: Pin, Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: If you successfully Pin an opponent with a Grapple attack (see Pin Feat for more details), you can immediately deal bludgeoning damage to it equal to your Unarmed damage or claw damage, whichever is greater.

prerequisite.text: Pin feat, and Base Attack Bonus 1

system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook

See also: Feats, Grappling 101

You are skilled at immobilizing Grappled foes.

Prerequisite: Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: If you succeed on a Grappling attack and your opponent fails the opposed Grapple check, your opponent is automatically Pinned until the start of your next turn. A Pinned creature can't move or take any Actions while Pinned, and it loses its Dexterity bonus (if any) to Reflex Defense.

Special: You cannot use the Pin and Trip Feats during the same round. You can use the Pin and Crush Feats in the same round, however.

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook

See also: Feats

You are considered Trained in a new Skill.

Effect: Choose one Untrained Skill from your list of Class Skills. You become Trained in that Skill.

Special: This Feat may be selected multiple times. Each time you take this Feat, it applies to a different Class Skill.

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook

See also: Feats

You are tougher than normal.

Effect: You gain +1 Hit Point per Character Level.

See also: Feats

You are proficient with a particular kind of weaponry.

Effect: Choose one Weapon Group. You are proficient with all weapons of the selected group. Weapon Groups include the following:

  • Simple Weapons (includes Simple Weapons (Melee), Simple Weapons (Ranged), and Grenades)
  • Pistols
  • Rifles
  • Lightsabers
  • Heavy Weapons (includes both Heavy Weapons and Vehicle Weapons)
  • Advanced Melee

Normal: If you wield a weapon with which you are not proficient, you take a -5 penalty to your attack rolls.

Special: You can gain this Feat multiple times. Each time you take the Feat, it applies to a different Weapon Group. You cannot take Exotic Weapons as a weapon group; instead you must select the Exotic Weapon Proficiency Feat to gain proficiency with a specific Exotic Weapon.

Additional Weapon Proficiency

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

Combined Feat (Quick Draw): You can draw and ignite your Lightsaber as a single Swift Action.
You may reroll any Perception check, but the result of the reroll must be accepted, even if it is worse. This Talent applies to Use Computer checks made to perceive enemy ships (see Use Sensors).
